coverage.description: run normalizes CRLF to LF, splits sentence blocks and joins by exact sent_id. Duplicate tree IDs keep the last form. Iterate unique label IDs in BTree order; witness-only/tree-only IDs add no output row. Missing act/form use the same empty defaults as agree_one. Emit one TSV row per retained label ID, count rule applications and form/act changes; move ties retain lexical order.

state: Report n equals distinct retained label-table IDs (including an empty ID on a nonempty TSV row), not raw rows, witnesses or changed rows. Rule totals can exceed n across multiple rules. Output fields retain id association; CRLF must preserve block boundaries. Polarity/hedge changes are not included in move counts.
